intent_contract.text: 어두운 달빛 아래 빗자루를 타고 날아가는 네코미미 마녀가 KF-21 전투기에 쫓기며 대응 사격을 하는 긴급히 찍은 듯한 실사 촬영 이미지
A photorealistic, urgently captured single-frame chase beneath dark moonlight: an adult cat-eared witch flies a broom, a KF-21 follows from behind, and she fires backward in response.

An urgent handheld documentary photograph at night: an unmistakably adult witch with pointed cat ears visible against the sky rides a single wooden broom under a dark moon. The broom's nose and her knees point along the flight path; her thighs grip its shaft and her left hand holds the forward shaft. She twists her shoulders over her right side and extends her right arm behind her, firing a bright defensive magic bolt backward along the chase line. A modern KF-21 fighter jet pursues from behind and below, smaller in the same frame, with its angular twin-tail silhouette caught in cold moonlight; the bolt travels toward its approach path. The camera tracks slightly ahead of her right flank, showing her right arm and the jet beyond the trailing bristles. The witch and broom dominate the near foreground while the pursuing fighter remains clearly recognizable through a break in wind-torn cloud. Her coat and hair stream backward toward the pursuer, and a slanted horizon conveys a split-second evasive maneuver. Cold blue moonlight outlines the ears, face, broom, and aircraft, while the magical discharge briefly lights her braced arm. Real lens grain, slight edge motion smear, atmospheric haze, and an imperfect off-center capture make the scene feel physically photographed during sudden danger.
